exposure: Application of an intelligent delivery room management system by midwives
outcome: Rate of vaginal delivery to caesarean section
cohort: The study included 100 primiparas admitted to the department of obstetrics and gynecology of a hospital from January 2019 to June 2020.
finding: The application of an intelligent delivery room management system by midwives significantly shortened labor stages, reduced postpartum pain, improved neonate Apgar scores, lowered the caesarean section rate, and decreased postpartum anxiety and depression.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal delivery to caesarean section was lower in the observation group that used the intelligent delivery room management system.
followup_time: Immediately postpartum for pain and Apgar score; after delivery for anxiety and depression scores (specific duration not mentioned).
